name: Ory Dockertest Go Integration Testing
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed Go integration-testing library that starts and manages Docker containers for tests, with readiness checks and cleanup; no vendor software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires access to a Docker-compatible daemon and container images; local or CI compute, image downloads and any hosted runner charges are not included. This is a Go testing library, not a hosted testing platform.
